sm: Make isInitiator fixed from the beginning of instance creation The SMP spec specifies that the initiator or responder role is fixed during the active LE link on which the SMP takes place. On ACL master the SM will be initiator and on ACL slave the SM will be responder. This CL makes isInitiator field fixed (unchanged) during the lifetime of the SM instance. BUG=chromium:971341 TEST=Manual test: Pair with a HID device, disconnect, reconnection, and check that there is no regression. This change adds a wrapper eclass 'cros-bazel' containing initial cross-compilation logic. video: Add resolution constraint for video_ChromeHWDecodeUsed test. video_ChromeHWDecodeUsed.vp8.mse was regressed on multiple board. The root cause is that it does not specify resolution on source video's URL. And its source, crosvideo.appspot.com, now sweeps all video resolutions up to 3840x2160, which triggers some devices' hardware decoders' reject the task. By specifying resolution=1080 constraint, the regression will be fixed. CHROMIUM: config: Turn off Rockchip crypto for arm64 Rockchip crypto is not a win on arm64 devices--it's better to use the normal arm64 crypto. See the linked bug. Let's turn it off. echo 'CONFIG_CRYPTO_DEV_ROCKCHIP=n' >> \ chromeos/config/arm64/chromiumos-arm64.flavour.config echo 'CONFIG_CRYPTO_DEV_ROCKCHIP=n' >> \ chromeos/config/arm64/chromiumos-rockchip64.flavour.config ./chromeos/scripts/kernelconfig olddefconfig NOTES: - actually this CL is a no-op (other than shrinking the kernel) since the crypto isn't enabled in the device tree anyway. - according to an email I have from Collabora there were some problems with the Rockchip crypto driver on arm64; not sure if that got fixed. The email I have said "The I/O helper is wrong in this driver, because it's not really I/O memory, but just 32-bit registers, and so 64-bit accessess don't work." - it seems like it _could_ be plausible that someone might someday find a way to use Rockchip's acceleration in conjunction with the normal arm64 crypto. If/when that days comes, we can always turn this back on. BUG=b:35579274 TEST=None Change-Id: Ifca50cd40fb0fdb3caa5b95585b7cf29cddf62b0 Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> (cherry picked from commit e321a30fd3144ea8e99014bd608cd5121afb4422) Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1693713 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>
